title: The hybrid ladder: code, SFT, per-document, GRPO
metric_note: Share of invoices whose eligible, blocked and deferred amounts are all within Rs 1 of the truth. Held-out test set, 120 simulator cases (60 in-distribution, 60 out-of-distribution), one number per bar.
source: reports/hybrid.md (Overall, 120 simulator cases) and reports/results.md at commit 83599e7. A step with no value is TODO: not run yet, shown as an empty dashed bar. Commit under each bar = the reconciler version that produced the number (e2e rows: the report commit).

context.title: Context accuracy and overclaim
context.sub: Same 120 test cases. Context = did the model apply the business context right (blocked and deferred reasons). Overclaim = rupees of credit wrongly claimed, per case.

footnotes: * SFT was trained on compact targets (zero fields omitted) but this run decoded with the strict full-schema grammar, which forces junk into blocked and deferred. Read it as a format mismatch, not as the student's accuracy.
Not measured (GPU host down): base Qwen3-4B end-to-end, and SFT end-to-end with the compact grammar. Both bars are left out rather than guessed.

Reconciler v1, v2 and v3 re-score the same cached per-document replies with no new model calls; the oracle check (true records through the same code) reproduces the truth on all cases under all three.
